title: 描眉画目：以骨相为基础，以眉形修饰五官
title_en: Miaomeihuamu: brow design grounded in bone structure and facial harmony
intro: 描眉画目·定制美学是一家私人定制纹绣工作室，主打仪器野生眉。乐乐老师的眉形设计，始终从每个人自身的五官与骨相出发，而不是套用固定的眉形模板。
intro_en: Miaomeihuamu is a private permanent makeup studio specialising in instrument hair-stroke brows. Lele’s brow design always begins with each person’s own features and bone structure, rather than a fixed brow template.

sections.title: 以骨相为基础，以眉形修饰五官
sections.title_en: Brow design grounded in bone structure and facial harmony
sections.description: 设计前，会综合观察五官的立体度、量感和整体风格，以及颧骨、眉眶骨的高低、眉眼关系和原生眉毛的生长方向。在尊重原有骨骼结构的基础上，通过调整眉头、眉峰、眉尾的位置、弧度与整体轮廓，修饰面部视觉比例，协调颧骨与眉眼之间的关系，让面部线条看起来更加流畅、舒展，并呈现更自然的立体感与折叠感。无论是温柔自然、清冷精致，还是利落英气的眉形，都可以结合顾客的五官特点、骨相基础、个人气质和审美需求进行设计。
sections.description_en: Before designing, she considers the depth, visual weight and overall character of the features, the height and prominence of the cheekbones and brow bone, the relationship between brows and eyes, and the direction of the existing brow hairs. Working with the existing bone structure, she adjusts the position and curvature of the brow start, arch and tail, along with the overall contour, to refine facial proportions visually and balance the relationship between the cheekbones and eye area. The aim is a smoother, more open visual flow, with natural depth and definition between facial planes. Whether you prefer soft and natural brows, a cool and refined look, or clean, strong definition, the design can be tailored to your features, bone structure, personal character and aesthetic preferences.

sections.title: 实际项目
sections.description: 提供手工野生眉、画派仪器野生眉、画派双仪器初绒野生眉、丝雾眉、绒雾眉、美瞳线、扩唇、改乌唇、纹发际线与纹人中窝。具体适用情况先评估。
sections.description_en: Services include manual, single-instrument and dual-instrument hair-stroke brows, silk-shaded and velvet-shaded brows, lash-line enhancement, lip-contour refinement, dark-lip correction, hairline pigmentation and philtrum shading. Each requires a suitability assessment.

sections.title: 工作室与预约
sections.description: 乐乐老师2016年进入纹绣行业，2024年8月开设工作室。本人一对一设计操作，到店设计免费约30–45分钟，所有项目一年内免费补色。
sections.description_en: Lele entered the field in 2016 and opened the studio in August 2024. She designs and performs the work personally, one client at a time. The design consultation is free, takes about 30–45 minutes, and all services include free touch-ups within one year.
